C1387.title: Mirai Botnet DDoS Attack on DNS Provider Dyn Causes Major Internet Outage
C1387.summary: The Mirai botnet became active in August 2016, peaked in September with massive DDoS attacks against Krebs on Security and OVH, and on October 21, 2016 launched an attack against DNS provider Dyn that left major US East Coast websites including Twitter, Netflix, and Reddit largely inaccessible. The attack leveraged hundreds of thousands of compromised IoT devices such as home routers and cameras, causing significant internet infrastructure disruption.
